import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_INF = 10000000;
    static final int GRID_SIZE = 12;
    static final int TIME_LIMIT = 62;
    static final int NODE_LIMIT = 210;
    static final int EDGE_LIMIT = 21000;

    static class Edge {
        int target;
        int capacity;
        Edge(int t, int c) { target = t; capacity = c; }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] network = new List[EDGE_LIMIT];
    static int[] adjacency = new int[NODE_LIMIT];
    static int edge_counter = 0;

    static void add_connection(int from, int to, int cap) {
        network[edge_counter] = new ArrayList<>();
        network[edge_counter].add(new Edge(to, cap));
        adjacency[edge_counter] = adjacency[from];
        adjacency[from] = edge_counter++;

        network[edge_counter] = new ArrayList<>();
        network[edge_counter].add(new Edge(from, 0));
        adjacency[edge_counter] = adjacency[to];
        adjacency[to] = edge_counter++;
    }

    static int[] level = new int[NODE_LIMIT];
    static int[] que = new int[NODE_LIMIT * 2];
    static int[] current_arc = new int[NODE_LIMIT];
    static int[] count_layer = new int[NODE_LIMIT];
    static int[] in_que = new int[NODE_LIMIT];
    static int[] prev_node = new int[NODE_LIMIT];

    static int dinic_flow(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(current_arc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(prev_node, -1);
        int qhead = 0, qtail = 0;
        que[qtail++] = sink;
        in_que[sink] = 1;
        count_layer[0]++;
        level[sink] = 0;

        while (qhead < qtail) {
            int u = que[qhead++];
            for (int idx = adjacency[u]; ~idx != 0; idx = adjacency[idx]) {
                int v = network[idx].get(0).target;
                if (in_que[v] == 0) {
                    que[qtail++] = v;
                    in_que[v] = 1;
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    count_layer[level[v]]++;
                    current_arc[v] = adjacency[v];
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0, min_edge = MAX_INF;
        int cur_node = source;
        prev_node[source] = source;

        while (level[source] < sink) {
            boolean extended = false;
            for (int arc = current_arc[cur_node]; ~arc != 0; arc = adjacency[arc]) {
                if (network[arc].get(0).capacity > 0 && 
                    level[network[arc].get(0).target] + 1 == level[cur_node]) {
                    extended = true;
                    min_edge = Math.min(min_edge, network[arc].get(0).capacity);
                    prev_node[network[arc].get(0).target] = cur_node;
                    cur_node = network[arc].get(0).target;
                    if (cur_node == sink) {
                        while (cur_node != source) {
                            cur_node = prev_node[cur_node];
                            network[current_arc[cur_node]].get(0).capacity -= min_edge;
                            network[current_arc[cur_node] ^ 1].get(0).capacity += min_edge;
                        }
                        flow += min_edge;
                        min_edge = MAX_INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (extended) continue;

            int nearest = sink + 1;
            for (int idx = adjacency[cur_node]; ~idx != 0; idx = adjacency[idx]) {
                if (network[idx].get(0).capacity > 0 && nearest > level[network[idx].get(0).target]) {
                    nearest = level[network[idx].get(0).target];
                    current_arc[cur_node] = idx;
                }
            }

            count_layer[level[cur_node]]--;
            if (count_layer[level[cur_node]] == 0) return flow;
            level[cur_node] = nearest + 1;
            count_layer[level[cur_node]]++;
            cur_node = prev_node[cur_node];
        }

        return flow;
    }

    static char[][] initial = new char[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static char[][] final_grid = new char[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[][] supply = new int[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[][] demand = new int[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[][][] fire = new int[TIME_LIMIT][GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[TIME_LIMIT][GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int n, T;

    static void evolve() {
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (fire[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        fire[t][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (fire[t-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        fire[t][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int ni = i + dx[k];
                            int nj = j + dy[k];
                            if (ni >= 1 && ni <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n) {
                                if (fire[t-1][ni][nj] == 2) {
                                    fire[t][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];

    static void expand_paths(int sx, int sy, int cx, int cy, int time) {
        visited[cx][cy] = true;
        dp[time][sx][sy][cx][cy] = 1;
        if (time >= T || fire[time][cx][cy] != 0) return;

        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = cx + dx[k];
            int ny = cy + dy[k];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && !visited[nx][ny]) {
                if (fire[time][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                expand_paths(sx, sy, nx, ny, time + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int dummy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100000; ++i) dummy++;

        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                initial[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (initial[i][j] == 'Z') fire[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (initial[i][j] == 'Y') fire[0][i][j] = 1;
                else supply[i][j] = initial[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                final_grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (final_grid[i][j] >= '0' && final_grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    demand[i][j] = final_grid[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        evolve();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (supply[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < GRID_SIZE; ++x)
                        Arrays.fill(visited[x], false);
                    expand_paths(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 1; k <= T; ++k) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int source = 0, target = n * n * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(adjacency, -1);
        edge_counter = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                add_connection(source, (i-1)*n + j, supply[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                add_connection(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, target, demand[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                        if (supply[x][y] != 0 && demand[nx][ny] != 0 && dp[T][x][y][nx][ny] != 0) {
                            add_connection((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, MAX_INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic_flow(source, target));
    }
}
